text:
Tasha: Morning async — quick check: SDK quickstarts, sample-app fixes, and a few doc nits. What I did yesterday: landed the node ESM quickstart updates; tweaked npm examples. Blockers: sample-app failing on mac M1 in CI. Today: triage CI + cut a tiny patch.
Alex: rolled docs site patch for the CLI flags. Noted a broken link in quickstart -> I'll submit a tiny PR in a bit. :thumbsup:
Maria: re: sample-app CI — error is during wheel build on macOS runner. Error snippet:
```
error: could not build wheel for fastapi-helpers
clang: error: unsupported option '-mavx'
```
Likely a binary build flag leaking into mac env.
Sam: quick workaround — add `--no-binary :all:` to `pip wheel` or pin the problematic dep to a source-only version. I'll try a matrix job with `MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=11` and report back.
Jeremy: I have a pending review on the sdk-quickstart PR (frontend examples). Can someone from docs glance? Mostly copy edits and one API param rename. Pinged @Tasha earlier.
Tasha: on the review, I can do a pass after CI green. Jeremy — can you add a short migration note to the quickstart (one-line) so users see the param rename? Also, Alex, if you post the link to the broken doc I'll fix it.
docs-bot: Reminder — doc lint pipeline will fail on trailing whitespace; see #docs-lint for logs.
Maria: Sam's matrix tweak fixed the wheel build locally. Will push a branch `mac-fix/dep-wheel` in ~15m. Need an extra pair for quick review before I merge.
Sam: happy to review — adding comments now. If it looks good, can we cut a micro-release for the sample-app so downstream quickstarts point to a stable tag?
Tasha: yes, let's do a micro-release after merge. Action items: Maria pushes fix -> Sam reviews -> Alex / Tasha merge doc fixes -> cut v0.1.1 sample-app. If anyone is blocked, call it out here. Thanks team! :rocket:
